# Ownership v1.0
# Comprehensive ownership and responsibility framework for prompt governance

ownership:
  version: "1.0"
  last_updated: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  
  # Ownership structure
  ownership_structure:
    organizational_levels:
      executive_level:
        - role: "governance_committee"
          description: "Overall governance and strategic oversight"
          responsibilities:
            - "Set strategic direction for prompt governance"
            - "Approve major policy changes"
            - "Ensure regulatory compliance"
            - "Manage high-risk decisions"
          authority_level: "strategic"
          decision_scope: "organization_wide"
          
      management_level:
        - role: "prompt_governance_manager"
          description: "Day-to-day governance management"
          responsibilities:
            - "Implement governance policies"
            - "Manage approval workflows"
            - "Coordinate cross-functional teams"
